description: E2B provides cloud sandboxes for AI agents to execute code, run tools, and manage isolated Linux environments. It also offers template, filesystem, process, and sandbox lifecycle capabilities around those environments.
summary: E2B exposes a public docs MCP server at `https://e2b.dev/mcp`, a sandbox-management HTTP API on `https://api.e2b.app` authenticated with an E2B API key, an envd HTTP API on `https://sandbox.e2b.app` routed by sandbox headers, and the `e2b` CLI.
